prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE horizontal animation strip for the Dotlings app, Drizzle, reviewing. Reference 1 is the exact canonical identity. Reference 2 is its original six-expression sheet for identity and eye-lid construction ONLY, not an output layout. Preserve EXACT original silhouette, colour, facial construction, short dense fuzzy plush fitting close to body, crown/leaves/curl/shape, and existing limb count. Identity: a little rainy cloud creature, a low slate-blue scalloped fluffy cloud body with three tiny soft blue rain droplets hanging just below its body, face on the cloud, all droplets stay well inside each cell.. All eyes remain fully glossy dark brown/black with tiny white catchlights ONLY; never white sclera or white crescent. All mouths CLOSED, tiny curved line smile or sad line, no mouth cavity, tongue or speaking. Original reference's open mouth MUST be replaced with a CLOSED line. No added feet/legs/arms, no added tufts or clothing. Preserve existing rain drops and lightning ONLY for a character whose reference already contains those. Same lighting, apparent body scale, baseline and consistent fur in every pose, except intentional jump height.
Exactly 6 COMPLETE separated full-body poses in ONE horizontal row, NOT a grid. 6 invisible equal-width slots, each character at most 65 percent of its slot width, substantial uninterrupted pure magenta gaps. Entire silhouettes visible with wide outer margins. Flat opaque pure magenta #FF00FF background throughout, keep magenta out of the pet. No scenery, floor, shadows, glow, labels, numbers, guides, borders, text, hearts, stars as effects, motion lines or blur. WIDE landscape canvas.
Sequence in exact left-to-right order: Sweet curious inspection: slightly incline upper face forward/down; tiny left inclination; tiny right inclination; relaxed blink; pleased tiny nod; neutral smile. NEVER angry eyebrows.
Keep it exceptionally cute, soft and sweet, with very small controlled movements matching the supplied identity. Do NOT simplify the fur into smooth plastic. Do NOT redesign the character.
